plans.idea: Centered poster: logo crowns the canvas, a bottle lineup row (large hero bottle plus the two secondary bottles beside it) sits in the middle, copy stacks below, and the pill CTA anchors the bottom center on a shared vertical axis.

Editorial split: a left text column (logo, headline, flavours, copy, CTA all on one left edge) reads top to bottom, balanced by the hero bottle on the right with the two companion bottles grouped beneath it.
Headline-first top band: logo and a wide full-width copy block own the upper half, then a bottom row reads left to right from the hero bottle, through the two companion bottles, to the CTA.
